data.finding: The current strategy is overly aggressive and reactive, resulting in reduced capital efficiency due to repeated withdrawals.
data.reasoning: This change departs from previous suggestions, such as increasing maxActionsPerHour, as cooling down the withdrawal cooldown period aims to reduce the agent's over-reaction to market fluctuations. By increasing the cooldown period to 720 seconds, the agent will have a better chance to assess the market and make more informed decisions, resulting in improved capital efficiency.
